content.title: How To Watch Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella 2026 Performance In Australia
content.text: We're ready for weekend 2! Michael B Jordan's Best Looks | marie claire0 seconds of 58 secondsVolume 0% Weekend two of Coachella is nearly upon us, and if the first weekend was anything to go by, we’re in for a spectacle. As one of the festival’s 2026 headliners, all eyes were on Sabrina Carpenter last weekend—and the pop star’s theatrical performance more than delivered. She opened night one in Indio, California by transforming the main stage into a glitzy, Hollywood-inspired set, complete with a sweeping, Hollywood Hills–esque “Sabrinawood” backdrop and a Walk of Fame-style runway. The wardrobe followed suit: glamorous, retro-leaning, and unmistakably in keeping with Carpenter’s signature aesthetic. The star cycled through four costume changes throughout the show, all designed by Jonathan Anderson. Back in spring 2024, Carpenter closed out her Coachella debut with a bold promise. “He’s drinking my bath water like it’s red wine/Coachella, see you back here when I headline,” she trilled during one of the ever-rotating outros of Nonsense. It was delivered with her usual wink—Carpenter’s music trades in double entendres and witty punchlines—but this time, she meant it. Two years later, she has returned to the desert as a headliner—and it’s everything we could have wanted and more. This year’s festival, also headlined by Justin Bieber and Karol G, has already delivered a slate of performances met with feverish crowds. Missed the first weekend? Consider this your second chance. Weekend two is about to begin, and whether you’re watching from the desert or your living room, here’s everything you need to know. What Time Will Sabrina Carpenter Perform At Coachella 2026? After headlining the first weekend on April 10, Sabrina Carpenter is set to return for weekend two on Friday, April 17. She’ll take to the Coachella stage from 9:00pm to 10:40pm local time, which translates to Saturday, April 18 from 2:00pm to 3:40pm AEST in Australia—slightly earlier than her weekend one slot. Below, find exactly when to tune in from your city. Coachella will once again livestream weekend two, with coverage spanning all major sets across the festival’s main stages. For Australians, Sabrina Carpenter’s performance begins at 2:00pm AEST on Saturday, April 18, making it an easy daytime watch from home. If you are wondering where to tune in, the full festival is available to stream for free on the official Coachella YouTube channel. No paid subscription is required, so you can dip in and out of sets or settle in for the full performance as it unfolds. What Songs Are On Sabrina Carpenter’s Coachella 2026 Setlist? Sabrina Carpenter’s weekend one setlist was a 20-song, hit-packed run featuring tracks like “Espresso,” “Taste,” “Manchild” and “Tears.” For weekend two, we expect a similarly high-energy lineup. Sabrina Carpenter performs at the Coachella Stage during the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival at Empire Polo Club on April 10, 2026 in Indio, California. Image: Getty For reference, the final set list for Sabrina Carpenter’s Coachella 2026 performance for weekend one: Intro (with Sam Elliott; contains elements of “Hollywood Swinging” by Kool & the Gang) House Tour (extended; contains elements of “In My House” by Mary Jane Girls) Taste Busy Woman (extended intro) Manchild (extended intro) Interlude (featuring dialogue from Some Like It Hot (1959)) When Did You Get Hot? (extended intro; live debut) Please Please Please We Almost Broke Up Again Last Night (live debut) Nobody’s Son because i liked a boy (shortened) My Man on Willpower Interlude (spoken word by Susan Sarandon & Corey Fogelmanis) Go Go Juice Such a Funny Way (live debut; shortened) Sugar Talking (live debut) Don’t Smile Feather (extended intro; contains elements of “Copacabana (At the Copa)” by Barry Manilow) Bed Chem Interlude (with Will Ferrell as a technician) Juno Espresso (extended intro) Goodbye (shortened) Tears (extended dance break version) “Hollywood Swinging” (Kool & the Gang, played from tape) Where Can I Watch Sabrina Carpenter’s Full Coachella Performance? If you missed the live stream last weekend, there’s a slight catch. Coachella doesn’t typically upload full sets after the fact, so a complete replay is unlikely, though clips and individual performances are shared on the festival’s YouTube channel. Missed weekend one? Weekend two offers a second chance. If you’re hoping to catch Sabrina Carpenter’s full set live, your best bet is to tune in on April 18 (Australian time), when she returns to the stage for her second weekend performance. Does Sabrina Carpenter’s Coachella Set Feature Any Special Guests? Yes! In keeping with the set’s Old Hollywood theme, Sabrina Carpenter enlisted a string of dazzling cameos, including Susan Sarandon, Will Ferrell, Samuel L. Jackson and Sam Elliott. Naturally, attention now turns to weekend two, and whether she might up the ante with musical guests. Taylor Swift’s name has already begun circulating, given the pair have collaborated multiple times. You never know!
